[EFFECT] The holiday feature acts as a simple on/off switch. On non-holidays (value = 0), the model sees virtually no effect on demand. On holidays (value = 1), the effect is mixed but skewed negative overall — most hours on holidays see reduced demand, with SHAP contributions ranging from about −1.2 to +0.5. The wide spread of holiday-hour contributions suggests that demand on holidays varies considerably depending on other conditions (such as time of day).

[IMPORTANCE] This is the least important feature in the model, ranked 9th out of 9. Its influence on demand is minimal compared to factors like hour of day, temperature, or weather.

[RECOMMENDATION] Since holidays generally, but not uniformly, reduce demand, consider slightly scaling back bike availability on public holidays — but monitor closely, as some holiday hours can still see normal or above-normal ridership.
